## MBW AI Carousels

- Sheet tab: `ai_carousels`
- Between 2 and 10 unique public HTTPS image URLs are required.
- `Testing` generates/validates copy and sends Telegram without publishing.
- `Scheduled` publishes only after the scheduled time, verified input, passing local review, and copy approval.
- Per-platform IDs prevent normal duplicate posts.
- A publishing lock stops automatic retries after an uncertain partial failure.
- Import inactive, refresh Google Sheets columns, run a review-only test, then activate.
